observed: Two real Workers started concurrently against a Fresh canonical MariaDB. Worker 2 aborted in @PostConstruct when its first registration transaction lost a MariaDB deadlock while inserting OPS_RUNTIME_INSTANCE_STATE.
rootCause: CpfRuntimeControlAgent performs exactly one startup registration attempt. A transient deadlock rolls back the whole correctly transactional register call, but the Agent treats that retryable database arbitration outcome as permanent startup failure.
